topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I found the scrap of paper where Elowen keeps her dreams, tucked away in the corner of the barn, where the hay whispers secrets. It speaks of far-off lands, of mountains I’ve only seen in the ragged edges of a traveling scribe’s map, of rivers that run with gold and cities made of stone so tall they speak to the clouds. Her hand has traced these words, these places, more times than the plow has cut the earth. I look at our field, the soil that’s fed us for seasons untold, and wonder if it ever felt the weight of her thoughts, wishing for something beyond the horizon. What good is a harvest if the heart wanders to distant fields?
